INSERT INTO law_article ( law_code, law_key, law_name, law_type, ministry, promulgation_no, promulgation_date, effective_date, unit_type, article_no, article_key, title, article_effective_date, content, revision_history, latest_revision_date ) VALUES
(#{a.lawCode}, #{a.lawKey}, #{a.lawName}, #{a.lawType}, #{a.ministry}, #{a.promulgationNo}, #{a.promulgationDate}, #{a.effectiveDate}, #{a.unitType}, #{a.articleNo}, #{a.articleKey}, #{a.title}, #{a.articleEffectiveDate}, #{a.content}, #{a.revisionHistory}, #{a.latestRevisionDate})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE law_key = VALUES(law_key), law_name = VALUES(law_name), law_type = VALUES(law_type), ministry = VALUES(ministry), promulgation_no = VALUES(promulgation_no), promulgation_date = VALUES(promulgation_date), effective_date = VALUES(effective_date), article_no = VALUES(article_no), title = VALUES(title), article_effective_date = VALUES(article_effective_date), content = VALUES(content), revision_history = VALUES(revision_history), latest_revision_date = VALUES(latest_revision_date)
